title: hieracium wilczekianum subsp. matajurense
intro: Hieracium wilczekianum subsp. matajurense, commonly known as Hieracium matajurense, is a rare and endangered species of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium matajurense are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit hepatoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium matajurense are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
